# Gaia GPS

> Gaia GPS is a comprehensive outdoor navigation platform offering trail guides, topographic maps, and GPS tracking for hiking, backpacking, and wilderness exploration worldwide.

Gaia GPS provides detailed trail information including elevation profiles, difficulty ratings, and GPS coordinates for thousands of hiking routes across the United States and internationally. The platform serves outdoor enthusiasts with tools for route planning, offline maps, and trail discovery in national forests, parks, and wilderness areas.

## Key Topics

- GPS navigation
- hiking trails
- topographic maps
- elevation profiles
- trail difficulty ratings
- offline maps
- route planning
- backpacking
- national forests
- wilderness areas
- loop trails
- one-way trails
- moderate difficulty
- elevation gain
- trail guides

## Featured United States Trails

- [Fire wave trail via Seven Wonders Trail and Fire Wave Trail - Nevada](https://www.gaiagps.com/hike/444017/fire-wave-trail-via-seven-wonders-trail-and-fire-wave-trail): Moderate trail to Fire Wave in Valley of Fire State Park, Nevada
- [Gallatin River via Bighorn Pass - Wyoming](https://www.gaiagps.com/hike/451848/gallatin-river-via-bighorn-pass): Moderate trail to Gallatin River in Yellowstone National Park
- [La Cumbre Peak Loop via Tunnel Trail - California](https://www.gaiagps.com/hike/5548/la-cumbre-peak-loop-via-tunnel-trail): Difficult loop to La Cumbre Peak in Los Padres National Forest
- [Archer's Fork Loop Trail Loop - Ohio](https://www.gaiagps.com/hike/363884/archers-fork-loop-trail-loop): Difficult 15-mile loop in Wayne National Forest, Ohio
- [Busch Spring via Mint Spring Trail - Arizona](https://www.gaiagps.com/hike/3857/busch-spring-via-mint-spring-trail): Easy trail to Busch Spring in Coronado National Forest, Arizona

## International Trail Guides

- [Way To/From Serlo Monastry - Sagarmatha](https://www.gaiagps.com/hike/458765/way-tofrom-serlo-monastry): Moderate trail to Serlo Monastery in Sagarmatha, Nepal
- [Julius Kugi Alpine Trail + Spp + VA + TP - Gorenjska](https://www.gaiagps.com/hike/388025/julius-kugi-alpine-trail-spp-va-tp): Moderate alpine trail in Gorenjska, Slovenia
- [Fu Yung Pit via Maclehose Trail - Hong Kong](https://www.gaiagps.com/hike/353048/fu-yung-pit-via-maclehose-trail): Difficult trail to Fu Yung Pit via Maclehose Trail, Hong Kong
- [Søndre Kolsåstopp - Oslo](https://www.gaiagps.com/hike/426744/sndre-kolsastopp): Moderate trail in Kolsås-Dælivann conservation area, Oslo
- [Ahar Waterfall via تۆچال به آهار - Tehran](https://www.gaiagps.com/hike/458854/ahar-waterfall-via): Moderate trail to Ahar Waterfall in Central Alborz, Tehran

## European Hiking Routes

- [Turó del Fito Loop via BV-5307 - Catalunya](https://www.gaiagps.com/hike/386049/turo-del-fito-loop-via-bv-5307): Moderate loop to Turó del Fito in Montseny Natural Park, Spain
- [Cerro del Sol Loop via Puente de los Siete Ojos - Andalucía](https://www.gaiagps.com/hike/375865/cerro-del-sol-loop-via-puente-de-los-siete-ojos): Moderate loop in Sierra Nevada National Park, Andalucía
- [Lommelse Gracht Loop - Limburg](https://www.gaiagps.com/hike/386238/lommelse-gracht-loop): Moderate loop trail in Limburg, Belgium
- [Rheinhöhenweg - Rheinland-Pfalz](https://www.gaiagps.com/hike/318990/rheinhohenweg): Difficult trail along Rheinhöhenweg in Rheinland-Pfalz, Germany

## Canadian Wilderness Routes

- [Mount Cline Route - Alberta](https://www.gaiagps.com/hike/505210/mount-cline-route): Moderate mountain route in Kootenay-Cline Provincial Park, Alberta
